messages:
lisa-sales: Customer asks for POC: control plane pinned to EU, inference running in their Canada on‑prem cluster, BYO‑KMS (possible HSM), and strict no external egress for request payloads. Need feasibility, preliminary SOW delta, and a short ops checklist. Who can take?

rachel-presales: we can do this with Redwood Private + customer data plane. Main questions: do model weights ever leave their network? If not, we deliver an on‑prem runtime package and only keep metadata in the EU control plane.

tom-eng: technical notes: mutual TLS between control plane and on‑prem agent is required. Proposed minimal routing config:
```yaml
control_plane: eu-west1
data_plane: onprem (customer-ca)
failover: disabled unless customer signs cross-border waiver
egress: restrict_to_customer_cidrs: true
```
If weights must never leave on‑prem we support that but need an airgapped installer and signed artifact push for updates.

priya-legal: I'll need the customer's exact org name and signing authority to review the BYOK/HSM addendum. HSM requirement triggers extra vendor attestation and may add lead time. Also confirm whether they permit small operational heartbeats to EU control plane.

rachel-presales: ballpark SOW numbers for sales: one‑time packaging + integration, BYOK work, ops onboarding, recurring private seat. Rough: Packaging/airgap: $30k one‑time; BYO‑KMS integration: $8k (HSM addl +$10k); Ops runbook & handoff: $4k; Private seat: $6k/mo. First month uplift ~ $48k with HSM, recurring +$6k/mo. Note: estimates pending engineering signoff.

tom-eng: ops ETA: 3 business days to wire cert rotation, monitoring hooks, and runbook if no airgap. Add ~4 days for airgap packaging and signing workflow. For model updates recommend signed tars pushed via SFTP or an artifact repo with signed manifests.

lisa-sales: action list: 1) @tom-eng confirm whether any control‑plane metadata (model version id, checksums) must exist in EU control plane or we can store only opaque IDs (EOD). 2) @priya-legal draft BYOK/HSM checklist and timeline (48–72h). 3) @finance‑bot convert rough numbers to SOW lines (48h). I'll schedule a customer call after we have answers.

deploy-bot: INF-3100 created: "bigbank-eu-controlplane-ca-onprem-byo-hsm-poc" — assignees: tom-eng, rachel-presales — due: 3d.

finance-bot: noted. Will produce SOW stub and tax/regulatory note for Canada within 48h.

lisa-sales: thanks team — I'll push the prep doc to the customer and include a short checklist for the call. :+1:
